bookings_status_timestamps.name: bookings_status_timestamps
bookings_status_timestamps.value:
("bookings"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "bookings"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        and ("bookings"."status" <> 'rejected' or "bookings"."rejected_at" is not null)
        and ("bookings"."status" <> 'completed' or "bookings"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("bookings"."status" <> 'confirmed' or "bookings"."confirmed_at" is not null)

profiles_full_name_length.name: profiles_full_name_length
profiles_full_name_length.value: "profiles"."full_name" is null or char_length("profiles"."full_name") between 1 and 80

stylist_services_duration_range.name: stylist_services_duration_range
stylist_services_duration_range.value: "stylist_services"."custom_duration_minutes" is null or ("stylist_services"."custom_duration_minutes" between 5 and 720 and "stylist_services"."custom_duration_minutes" % 5 = 0)
